text: Welcome! Feel free to look around and get\nacquainted with our Elite Four team!

label: sdc02_4kings_a_01_clerk_01
text: Welcome to the Savanna Plaza! We’re the team\nthat supports Crispin of the Elite Four!

label: sdc02_4kings_a_01_clerk_03
text: You’ll need to hand over 50 BP if you want\nto take on the Elite Trial here.\c\nAre you ready and willing to pay?

label: sdc02_4kings_a_01_clerk_04
text: Oh, but...it looks like you don’t have enough BP.\nYou can earn some by taking on BBQs, though!

label: sdc02_4kings_a_01_clerk_05
text: Thank you very much! Duly received and noted!

label: sdc02_4kings_a_01_clerk_06
